data.name: Paladin
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses paladin as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses paladin as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Code: At 1st level, she must follow the paladin's code of conduct and gains the paladin's aura of good.
&nl;Detect Evil: At 3rd level, she can detect evil as a 1st-level paladin.
&nl;Lay on Hands: At 7th level, she gains the ability to lay on hands a number of times per day equal to 1/2 her character level, healing as much as a paladin of her character level - 4.
&nl;Smite Evil: At 11th level, she gains the ability to smite evil once per day as a paladin of her character level - 4.
&nl;Mercy: At 15th level, she selects one mercy from the paladin's 3rd-level mercy list.
&nl;Divine Bond: At 19th level, she gains a divine bond to a weapon as a paladin of her character level - 3.
